# DeliveryGuard package provenance

`deliveryguard-0.1.0-f6907ee.tgz` was built from the official
[`wzf1997/delivery-harness`](https://github.com/wzf1997/delivery-harness)
repository at commit `f6907eea4b9e385fa5d8fc1b466c5254fb059c46`.

The package is vendored because `deliveryguard@0.1.0` was not available from
the npm registry when this repository was configured, and installing the
GitHub-generated source tarball failed in the upstream `prepack` documentation
check because Git metadata is absent from that tarball.

The official source checkout passed its type check, 18 tests, build, CLI smoke
check, documentation link check, asset check, and sensitive-content scan before
this package was created with `pnpm pack`.
